rounds.title: The first light
rounds.brief: A moth finds one lantern in a sleeping harbor. Where should it carry the light?

candidates.title: Light the bridge
candidates.alt: A moth's amber lantern lights a footbridge over dark tidewater.

candidates.title: Wake the lighthouse
candidates.alt: A moth lights an empty lighthouse and guides a boat toward shore.

rounds.title: Lights across the harbor
rounds.brief: The villagers see the first light. Choose how the harbor answers.

candidates.title: Light the windows
candidates.alt: A trail of lanterns climbs from the quay to the houses on the hill.

candidates.title: Send lights out to sea
candidates.alt: Villagers send small lanterns across the harbor toward returning boats.
